workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because any headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break); parity 'any', so each section opens on the next page with no blank

col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId, because 1.4.1 does not apply colorPalette to design elements or to bodyText.referenceColor (gotcha palette-skips-designs); the :::part palettes still recolour the opener strips and the running feet through the paletteId, and referenceColor is set in ink explicitly
design text lineHeight is a multiple of the size (0.9, 1.04, 1.3): a pt() value silently drops an opener's reserved height in 1.4.1 (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)
the group heads of the income statement are merged with mergeCells, which writes the hiddenBy placeholder cells a colSpan needs (gotcha merged-cells-hiddenby)

the aside's space below is padding.bottom (3.5 mm), not marginBottom: 1.4.1 ignores calloutStyles[].marginBottom on a floated page-wide box, and the padding moves Table 1 and Chart 2 on p. 4 one grid line clear of its last line

gains end in a no-break space as wide as a bracket followed by a word joiner (U+2060): 1.4.1 trims trailing whitespace in table cells, U+00A0 included, and without the joiner the digits of gains would stand one bracket to the right of the losses'
